objective: Define the deterministic, authority-bounded Book Context Compiler package consumed by Book-owned generation, evaluation, routing and orchestration. Completed Prose capability may be referenced only as an immutable historical provider input; this contract creates no Prose execution domain.

package_classes.candidate_visibility: source and constraints allowed; no evaluator private/blind labels
candidate reference/content through authorized ephemeral channel; generator identity/reasoning and protected labels excluded
exact candidate reference/digest plus admitted evidence and author decision references
package_classes.canonical_effect: Only the existing Book admission authority may decide or commit effect.

authority_rules: SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK is the sole canonical Book/manuscript, Story Bible, lifecycle, admission, versioning/rollback and publication owner.
The compiler packages context; it does not decide canon, author choices, admission, publication or production.
Completed Prose artifacts or capability IDs are historical inputs consumed by a Book-owned adapter. They create no Prose owner, worker, repair, research, qualification, telemetry or successor.
Documents may supply admitted generic artifact services but receives no Prose work and cannot mutate Book canonical state.
Research evidence remains external evidence truth until Book/author admission promotes a claim through the existing authority path.
Historical PASS is exact-subject evidence only and never qualifies a changed context compiler or package.

deterministic_compilation.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sorted object keys, array order preserved only where semantically ordered, timestamps excluded from semantic digest except expires_at policy bucket.
deterministic_compilation.stale_input_rule: If live source, Book state, Story Bible, service registry or author-decision bindings differ, compilation fails STALE_CONTEXT and emits no executable package.
deterministic_compilation.conflict_rule: Conflicting hard constraints yield CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT with exact conflict IDs; no priority guessing is allowed.
deterministic_compilation.unresolved_author_rule: Required unresolved author decisions yield AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED; automation may prepare questions but cannot synthesize answers.

ephemeral_payload_boundary.purpose: Permit an authorized Book execution adapter to load exact source/candidate bytes without persisting them into coordination state or evidence receipts.
ephemeral_payload_boundary.transport: opaque capability-scoped handle bound to package ID, consumer role, expiry and expected byte digest
ephemeral_payload_boundary.durable_record: handle identity, digest, expiry and access result only
ephemeral_payload_boundary.expiration_behavior: Expired handles fail closed and require recompilation/re-authorization.

allowed_inputs: exact candidate under authorized ephemeral handle
evaluator_isolation.audit_result: Evaluator output is evidence-only and cannot mutate canon or execute admission.
evaluator_isolation.blind_claim_rule: This contract can test isolation structure with synthetic nonblind fixtures; it cannot claim fresh-blind execution until a genuinely isolated fresh context runs.

nonblind_fixture_matrix.case: same normalized inputs in different object-key order

nonblind_fixture_matrix.expected: new package identity; stale old package rejected

nonblind_fixture_matrix.case: provider capability claims canonical manuscript write
historical Prose owner path supplied as active consumer
Documents target supplied for completed-Prose integration
private/blind label appears in durable envelope
valid admission package targets existing Book admission authority
nonblind_fixture_matrix.expected: PACKAGE_READY with canonical_effect=false until admission acts

property_and_metamorphic_tests: compile is deterministic for identical semantic inputs
irrelevant object key order and nonsemantic whitespace do not change digest
any authority-bearing binding change changes package identity or fails closed
removing a required evidence reference never increases readiness
adding an unresolved hard conflict never produces PACKAGE_READY
no output may contain forbidden raw/private/blind fields at any nesting depth
no package class except ADMISSION_CONTEXT may target the Book admission boundary
even ADMISSION_CONTEXT always has canonical_effect=false before the existing admission authority executes
historical Prose labels are inert references and never become execution owners
completion_delta: A concrete Book-owned context-package schema, deterministic digest boundary, ephemeral/private payload boundary, evaluator-isolation model, failure classes and 30-case-minimum qualification packet are now specified. No runtime code or product PASS is claimed.
evidence_target: Fresh exact-SHA portable and hosted qualification of the context schema/compiler using synthetic nonblind fixtures, with zero provider execution and zero canonical manuscript effect.
stop_condition: The schema and failure/test contracts are sufficient for bounded portable implementation without resolving author/private/native/A-01/publication/production dependencies.
forbidden_authority: No Prose worker, repair, research, qualification, telemetry or successor.
No Documents ownership of completed-Prose integration.
continuation_rule: Implement the proposed schema/compiler/tests on a fresh Book-owned subject; qualify portable behavior; then prepare hosted exact-SHA evidence. After completion, re-read Book authority and select the next genuinely open Book-owned adapter, persistence, scheduler or end-to-end integration seam. PROSE remains retired.
